title: FlashSystem Grid
items: A scale-out architecture that adds independent systems to create a federated cluster
A RAID layout across FlashCore modules
A replication partnership between two sites
FlashSystem Grid 以加入多個獨立系統組成 Federated Cluster 的方式橫向擴充。
Up to how many systems can a FlashSystem grid support?
每個 FlashSystem Grid 最多支援 32 個系統，效能、容量與 Volume、Host、Snapshot 數量線性成長。
How does a FlashSystem grid compare to a traditional scale-out system that uses I/O groups?
It allows greater scalability with linear growth and independent updates
It requires all systems to update together
相較於以 I/O Group 擴充的傳統架構，Grid 擴充性更高，成員可獨立更新並混合不同型號與世代。
Can systems with different hardware models and generations be included in one FlashSystem grid?
No, all must be the same model
Only if they share a code level
同一 Grid 可包含不同硬體型號與世代，便於硬體汰換或分層。
What determines the maximum number of systems in a FlashSystem grid?
The software version running on the coordinator system
The size of the largest pool
Grid 可容納的最大系統數取決於 Coordinator 系統的軟體版本；舊版成員可能出現驗證錯誤。
How can storage partitions be moved between systems in a FlashSystem grid?
Only by remote copy with downtime
Storage Partition 可在 Grid 內的系統之間不中斷移轉。
How many I/O groups can a system in a FlashSystem grid have?
A maximum of one, with the multiple I/O group compatibility mode disabled
Grid 成員最多只能有一個 I/O Group，且必須停用多 I/O Group 相容模式。
Which system topology is required for FlashSystem grid members?
Grid 成員的 System Topology 必須為 Standard。
Which system layer is required for FlashSystem grid members?
Grid 成員的 System Layer 必須為 Replication。
Which option is supported for system management IP addresses in a FlashSystem grid?
IPv4 using FQDN with a DNS server configured
Grid 成員管理 IP 可用 IPv4、IPv6，或搭配已設定 DNS 的 FQDN，以及 IPv4 與 FQDN 混合。
What type of certificates do grid members use by default for secure communication?
Self-signed host certificates from IP quorum
Grid 成員交換憑證以安全通訊，預設為 System-signed 憑證。
If a system running 8.7.2 or older is part of a grid, what must you do before upgrading it to the current version?
Update the existing FlashSystem grid configuration
Convert it to a stretched system
8.7.2 或更舊版本的 Grid 成員，升級前必須先更新既有 Grid Configuration。
The system on which the grid is created and managed, which also becomes the first member
The system with the most capacity
Coordinator 是建立與管理 Grid 的系統，也是 Grid 的第一個成員。
Where do you create a new FlashSystem grid in the management GUI?
Settings > System > FlashSystem grid > Create a new FlashSystem grid
於 Settings > System > FlashSystem grid 選 Create a new FlashSystem grid；CLI 為 managegrid。
Which CLI command creates and manages a FlashSystem grid?
`managegrid` 用於建立 Grid、加入、接受、移除與離開等操作。
How can a system join an existing grid from its own GUI?
Settings > System > FlashSystem grid > Join an existing FlashSystem grid, then enter the coordinator address
It cannot; only the coordinator can add it
成員端可選 Join an existing FlashSystem grid，輸入 Coordinator 的 IP 或 FQDN，GUI 會引導驗證並交換憑證。
When adding a system to a grid with the CLI, which command adds the coordinator certificate to the truststore?
以 `lssystemcertstore`、`chsystemcertstore` 取得憑證，再用 `mktruststore` 加入 Truststore，之後以 join 選項申請加入。
When adding a system to the grid by CLI, what does the coordinator do after the new system requests to join?
Accepts the request with the accept option
新系統以 join 申請後，Coordinator 需加入新系統憑證到 Truststore，並以 accept 選項接受。
Which information does the FlashSystem grid dashboard show?
Health, reachability, aggregated capacity, migrations, and AI suggestions
Grid Dashboard 顯示硬體健康、可連線狀態、彙總容量、移轉狀態與 AI Suggestions。
Concept Guide Ch10 Viewing a FlashSystem grid
When is logical capacity visible on the FlashSystem grid dashboard?
Only if FCM drives are used in all systems of the grid
Grid Dashboard 的 Logical Capacity 只有在所有系統都使用 FCM Drive 時才會顯示。
Where do the AI suggestions on the grid dashboard come from?
AI Suggestions 是 IBM Storage Insights 依整個 Grid 的歷史資料分析產生的建議。
Which component is NOT checked by the connectivity health status on the Storage systems page?
Connectivity Health 檢查 Hosts、Partnerships、Call Home、Key Servers、Email/SMTP 與 LDAP Servers。
Which CLI commands can be used to visualize the FlashSystem grid?
可使用 lsgrid、lsgridsystem、lsgridmembers 與 lsgridpartition 檢視 Grid。
When can a system NOT be removed from a FlashSystem grid?
When a partition migration to or from it is in progress
若有 Partition 移轉正在進出該系統，需等移轉完成才能移除。
Concept Guide Ch10 Removing a system
What happens when you run the leave option from the coordinator system?
The coordinator leaves and the FlashSystem grid is deleted
在 Coordinator 執行 leave 會讓它離開並刪除整個 Grid。
What happens when you run the leave option from a member system?
It partially removes the member; the coordinator must also use -remove to complete removal
It promotes the member to coordinator
在成員端執行 leave 只會部分移除，需在 Coordinator 對該成員執行 -remove 才能完全移除。
What happens to truststore entries when a member system is removed from a grid?
They are kept for future use
They are moved to the coordinator
移除成員時，加入時建立的 Truststore 項目會被移除。
Which systems can a member remove from the grid?
成員只能移除自己，Coordinator 則可移除 Grid 中任何系統。
What happens when the last system is removed from a FlashSystem grid?
The grid moves to Storage Insights
移除最後一個系統會刪除 Grid。
During grid onboarding, what must be done on a new system before adding it from the coordinator?
Initialize it, enter the cluster management IP, save, and restart
Fully configure it with pools and hosts
Upgrade it to the coordinator's code level manually
Onboarding 前先初始化系統、輸入管理 IP 與選用 DNS、儲存並重新啟動。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch10 onboarding
Automatic initialization of newly detected systems through the grid applies to which systems?
Systems connected over a Fibre Channel fabric
Newly detected systems 的自動初始化只適用於透過 FC Fabric 連接的系統。
Why does grid onboarding prompt you to reset the password on an unconfigured system?
To ensure the system is not added with default credentials
Onboarding 會要求重設密碼，避免系統以預設認證加入。
During onboarding, from where does the new system import configuration?
The grid coordinator or a grid reference system with a compatible code level
新系統從 Coordinator 或相容版本的 Grid Reference System 匯入 Configuration，可取消不需要的設定群組。
Can required settings be deselected during onboarding configuration import?
Required Settings 為必要設定，不能取消勾選。
Which settings are entered separately as system-specific information during onboarding?
Call Home, Storage Insights, telemetry sharing, or encryption
Call Home、Storage Insights、Telemetry 分享或加密等屬系統專屬資訊，需另行設定。
What should you avoid on a system whose setup is being completed through the FlashSystem grid?
官方提醒若透過 Grid 完成設定，不要另外執行初始 Configuration。
From where can you assign a new coordinator by using the GUI?
Only from the current coordinator, using Assign as coordinator
GUI 的 Assign as coordinator 只能從目前的 Coordinator 操作。
Which CLI command makes a system the new coordinator?
managegrid -makecoordinator, run on the new coordinator
If the current coordinator is offline, how can you change the coordinator?
Only by using the CLI, choosing the member with the latest grid_gen_num
目前 Coordinator 離線時只能用 CLI，選擇 grid_gen_num 最新的成員 (以 lsgridsystem 檢查)。
When migrating a multi-I/O group system to a grid, from which I/O group do you start?
The I/O group with the most volumes
可不中斷地逐步移轉，從編號最低的 I/O Group 開始。
After moving resources off one I/O group during migration to a grid, what is done?
The nodes of that I/O group are removed
移轉完一個 I/O Group 的資源後移除其 Nodes，重複直到只剩一個 I/O Group。
Which configuration is NOT supported for migrating a multi-I/O group system to a grid without first removing it?
已設定 Policy-based Replication 的系統不支援，須先取消。
What must be contacted before migrating an Enhanced Stretched system to a grid?
Enhanced Stretched 系統需先聯絡 IBM Support。
What is required for the draft partition when migrating a multi-I/O group system to a grid?
Only one draft partition, containing only objects mapped to the lowest I/O group
Multiple draft partitions, one per I/O group
A draft partition with all objects
需啟用 Partition Migration，且只能有一個 Draft Partition，只包含映射到最低 I/O Group 的物件。
In grid multi-tenancy, what can a Grid Administrator do?
View all systems and partitions, create and manage tenants, and configure HA and DR
Only manage volumes in assigned pools
Grid Administrator 管理整個 Grid 與 Tenant，包含規劃容量、設定 HA 與 DR、維護系統健康與 System-scoped Snapshot Policy。
What can a Tenant Administrator see?
Only the systems and partitions assigned to that tenant
Tenant Administrator 只看得到指派給該 Tenant 的系統與 Partition，並在指派的 Pool 上管理 Volume Group。
How is tenant isolation achieved in grid multi-tenancy?
建立 Tenant 時指定名稱、系統，並建立專屬 User Group 與使用者，以 Ownership Group 達成 Isolation。
When partitions migrate within the grid, what keeps automation credentials working?
Partition users with the partition IP endpoint
Partition 在 Grid 內移轉時，Partition User 搭配 Partition IP 端點讓自動化憑證持續有效。
What does the View FlashSystem grid operations option do?
Navigates to the grid's Storage systems page in IBM Storage Insights
View FlashSystem grid operations 會導向 IBM Storage Insights 中對應 Grid 的 Storage systems 頁面。
What is shown on the Storage partitions page of a FlashSystem grid?
Partition location, replication topology and status, volume groups, migration status, and placement evaluation status
Grid 的 Storage partitions 頁面列出 Partition 位置、Replication Topology 與狀態、Volume Group、移轉狀態與 Placement Evaluation 狀態。
